text:
alex: Quick heads-up — nightly serving job shows a perf regression after last kernel selection change. KV cache hit-rate dropped ~78% -> 52% and we're seeing GPU mem climb + OOMs on p3d canaries. Anyone triaging?

sana: saw the alerts. I ran a perf profile; batching now creates many tiny KV entries because the new kernel path (fp16-lt) keeps small prefix frames alive longer. Flame snippet points to prompt canonicalizer + batching boundary.

kevin: is this from PR #4821 (kernel-path heuristics + canonicalizer change)? I reverted it locally and hit-rate jumped back to ~76%.

maira: yep that's the PR. we switched to the "normalized-prefix-v2" canonicalizer to reduce collisions but it accidentally includes ephemeral trace ids in the normalized key. that inflates unique keys and defeats warmup.

sana: repro steps I used: `./run_simulator --seed 42 --workload prefix-heavy --batcher=continuous` then `jq .metrics` gave:
```
{
  "kv_hit_rate": "0.52",
  "gpu_mem_mb": "13740",
  "kernel_path": "fp16-lt",
  "evictions_per_min": "420"
}
```
After reverting normalization:
```
{
  "kv_hit_rate": "0.76",
  "gpu_mem_mb": "11120",
  "kernel_path": "fp16-fast",
  "evictions_per_min": "95"
}
```

kevin: clear repro. seems canonicalizer appended `trace_id` for debugability. Fix: strip trace ids and keep canonicalizer deterministic + stable across warmup. Hotfix patch idea: revert the part that adds `-trace-` suffix and add unit test asserting stable-key for same logical prefix.

linh: also noticed the eviction sweeper is aggressive under memory pressure. when free GPU < 600MB we switch to slab-compaction which magnifies fragmentation. As a short-term mitigation increase softcap threshold to 1GB for p3d instance types so we don't thrash slabs on short-lived spikes. longer term we should adjust sweep aggressiveness based on fragmentation score, not absolute free mem.

alex: sounds reasonable. can we rollback kernel-path heuristics until hotfix lands? or at least canary the fix? @oncall-bot can you schedule a canary?

oncall-bot: scheduled canary deploy for 02:00 UTC with traffic-weight=5%. will monitor metrics: `kv_hit_rate`, `gpu_oom_count`, `evictions_per_min`. alerts if kv_hit_rate drops >10% or OOMs >1 in 10m. :eyes:

maira: I'll open PR with the hotfix + synthetic replay test (prefix-heavy workload) and add a microbenchmark for canonicalizer entropy. assigning to @kevin for review.

kevin: I'll review tonight. if green we can promote canary -> rollout and also bump softcap temporarily in runtime config. I'll add a changelog note referencing the perf regression and the regression test.

alex: thanks all. follow ups: maira add the failing sim to nightly, linchpin the softcap change behind a feature-flag so we can revert quickly. :thumbsup:
